column1: # Explicit public-file inventory. Format: policy<TAB>repository-relative path.
# copy+require: include the local file even before git tracking, then require it in the artifact.
# copy: include the local file if present; absence is not a build error.
# require: require it in the artifact without granting an additional untracked-file inclusion.
# Other tracked-file and asset-glob rules remain in scripts/build-site.sh.
# Keep requirement order stable; every path is declared once. See README.md.
